items.question: What suffering afflicts beings within the eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams?
items.inference: Beings are subjected to torment throughout the vast array of eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
uncertainties: The subject of pīḍitāḥ is implied from context rather than explicitly stated in this verse.
items.plain_english: They are tormented in the eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
